name: Raise
source:
Raise – is a character in Heralds of the Avirentes - Ch. 1 Wings of Change.
A black blue-eyed cat-faced yung om'verai with 4 light head horns. Wears pale guard armor, covering shoulders and wings, as well as decorating Raise's neck with a bracelet and a 5-directed helmet.
Azaries describes Raise as a "prankster", who used to "interrupt classes at school for hours". Changed int a serious and responsible person after becoming a municipality guard.
